# udoma_public_chatbot_instruction (Resource)

Resource represents a single instruction in the public chatbot knowledge base.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instruction` (String) The instruction text used by the chatbot as its knowledge base.
- `name` (String) Short, descriptive name of the instruction topic.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Order in which instructions are passed to the chatbot; lower values are processed first.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The date and time the instruction was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the public chatbot instruction.
- `updated_at` (Number) The date and time the instruction was last modified.
